events.name: Global Blockchain Congress
events.description: AgoraGroup is hosting its 2nd Southeast Asian edition of the Global Blockchain Congress on September 12th and 13th, 2024, in Singapore. The Global Blockchain Congress leverages the experience gained through the hosting of the first 13 editions of the event in Dubai and the international editions in Vietnam and the UK to ensure maximum return on investment for all our sponsors. This is not a conference nor an exhibition. This is an exclusive, closed-door, congress between investors and hand-picked Blockchain projects looking to raise funds. It is the only event of its kind and it will bring together qualified investors with Digital Assets Startups through a series of pre-scheduled and pre-arranged one-on-one meetings.

# CARROT CASTLE 
## EthDenver 2025
### [Incented](https://incented.co/), [Nearchos](https://nearchos.xyz/), [RnDAO](https://x.com/RnDAO__) and [Chones](https://chones.xyz/) invite you to the Carrot Castle during EthDenver, for a week of all things grants!
## What to Expect
- Root for your favorite project, as they **compete in a pitch fest battle**!
- Win funding in **custom grant rounds**!
- Try out **new integrations and tools** for better coordination around resource allocation!
- Prove you've **learned or taught something** useful!
- Join in **curated discussions** and shared meals.
- **Soak in a hot tub** during the coldest month in CO!

## Location & Programming
- Only 10 minutes from National Western!
- Subscribe to Carrot Castle Calendar (coming soon!) for up to date programming.
- RSVP for an NFT and networking via [Icebreaker](https://app.icebreaker.xyz/unlock/event/carrot-castle-knight-nibbles-a-lot).
### Carrot Castle is a *pay what you can event*. We appreciate your support in choosing a 25 or 150 USDC donation, but would rather you join us, than let ticket price discourage. 
- 🐰 Grand Hopper of Chompington (Tier 1 - 150 USDC) – The highest-ranking bunny in the land, with the grandest carrot feast!
- ⚔️ Knight Nibbles-a-Lot (Tier 2 - 25 USDC) – A valiant protector of the royal carrot hoard.
- 🔧 Artificer Sniffles (Tier 3 - free) – A bunny apprentice experimenting with carrot-powered inventions!
### Start making friends in the [Carrot Castle Telegram channel.](https://t.me/+wgSFFfYS8-tjZjgx)

events.name: Ethereum Korea One: Genesis
events.description:
Ethereum Korea One is Korea's flagship Ethereum conference, hosted by the Ethereum Korea Consortium — the first group in Korea formed on the back of an official grant from the Ethereum Foundation. Across two days (Day 1 for institutions, Day 2 for builders) it examines the role and the open challenges of Ethereum as truly neutral infrastructure, in the words of the players shaping it.

Day 1 — Institutional (Sep 28, Yeouido, Seoul)
Stablecoins, RWAs, and institutional capital are converging on Ethereum. Day 1 traces why this is happening on Ethereum, and what is actually being built on top of it, in the voices of the players driving it.

Day 2 — Builder (Sep 29, Seongsu, Seoul)
Day 2 is about Ethereum's long-term roadmap and direction, not short-term narratives. Taking Devcon's small-format sessions as a reference, it is built for an atmosphere where speakers and panelists keep the conversation going long after their sessions end.

Bypassing retail noise, this exclusive summit is built to empower Korea's traditional financial leaders to connect
with world-class blockchain infrastructure and shape the future of capital markets.

The Africa Stablecoin Summit 2026, taking place on 12th–13th November 2026 in Johannesburg, South Africa, convenes senior decision-makers to address this transition under the theme “Stablecoins at Scale: Institutional Adoption & Financial Infrastructure.”

The summit will focus on practical integration, policy alignment, risk standards, interoperability, custody, and treasury applications, providing a structured platform for institutions shaping the next phase of
Africa’s digital financial infrastructure.

In just its second year, Toronto Tech Week 2026 became a citywide reflection of what makes this ecosystem special: ambitious founders, operators, investors, builders, students, creators, and community leaders from across 87 countries came together to connect, share ideas, and champion one another.

Thank you to every host, speaker, partner, attendee, volunteer, and supporter who helped bring the week to life and shine a global spotlight on the people and companies building the future from Toronto and across Canada.

events.name: Proof of Talk
events.description:
Most conferences measure success in crowd size.
We measure it by who is in the room.

No pay-to-speak. No 150 side events. One venue, one curated room of the people who can actually sign a deal, returning to the Louvre Palace in 2027.

events.name: London Tech Week 2027
events.description:
Welcome to London Tech Week, the premier destination for innovation, collaboration, and growth in the tech industry. Each June at Olympia London, we bring together the brightest minds, visionary leaders, and cutting-edge solutions to shape the future of business.

Join us in exploring transformative ideas, connecting with global influencers, and discovering the technologies that will redefine industries. Whether you're an entrepreneur, executive, or innovator, London Tech Week is your gateway to the insights, connections and opportunities that power growth.

events.name: SuperReturn
events.description:
Where everyone who’s anyone in private markets meets.
The most LPs. The most GPs. The best investment opportunities.

events.name: The AI Summit London 2027
events.description: The AI Summit London is one of the world's leading commercial AI conferences, bringing together business leaders, AI practitioners, startups, investors, and technology innovators to explore real-world AI applications. The event features keynote sessions, enterprise case studies, exhibitions, and networking during London Tech Week

events.name: Chicago Family Office & High Net Worth Conference
events.description: From an overview of the financial markets to investments in real estate, technology, and alternatives; through estate planning, preparing the next generation, woman entrepreneurship, and family business to topics such as dealing with depression and addictions, philanthropy, impact investing and the arts.

events.name: ETHConf
events.description: Three days of focused conversations with the founders, builders, institutions, and policymakers moving the EVM ecosystem forward. Expect candid mainstage discussions, technical sessions, product showcases, and the time to build relationships with people working across the onchain economy from new startups to established financial institutions.

events.name: SBC Summit Canada
events.description:
SBC Summit Canada remains the only event fully dedicated to the Canadian market, offering a focused environment for stakeholders who want to engage exclusively on local opportunities. With a legacy spanning more than two decades, it continues to evolve alongside the industry, particularly as new developments such as Alberta’s anticipated launch come into focus.

The event brings together the entire ecosystem, from international operators and Crown corporations to regulators, First Nations-run businesses, affiliates, and the suppliers powering the industry, from game studios to payment providers and beyond.

Next year, SBC Summit Canada will return to its established June position in the calendar, taking place on 15–17 June 2027.

As we look ahead, we encourage early discussions around exhibition, sponsorship, and speaking opportunities for 2027, as availability is limited and demand continues to grow.

events.name: VivaTech 2026
events.description: VivaTech is Europe's largest startup and technology event, bringing together startups, investors, enterprises, policymakers, and innovators to showcase the latest breakthroughs in AI, deep tech, sustainability, and digital transformation. The event features world-class keynotes, startup exhibitions, networking, and innovation showcases.

events.name: TOKEN2049 New York
events.description:
THE GLOBAL CRYPTO INDUSTRY. NOW IN NEW YORK.
Following Singapore and Dubai, TOKEN2049 arrives at the centre of global finance.

Our inaugural New York edition will bring together 15,000 attendees from around the world. Meet the people building the companies, deploying the capital and defining the future of digital assets.

events.name: The Family Office Forum London
events.description: The London 2027 Edition of our Family Office Forum Collection will again welcome 100+ Family Offices and UHNWIs based in the UK and beyond.

events.name: Signal Week
events.description: Signal Week is not a rebrand of Paris Blockchain Week. It is an elevation. Where Paris Blockchain Week built credibility as Europe's leading institutional digital assets conference, Signal Week takes that credibility and positions it for the decade ahead - under a name that matches where the industry actually is.

events.name: Bitcoin Asia
events.description: Hong Kong is where the exchanges, the builders, the allocators, and the community driving Bitcoin across the region come together under one roof. In 2027 we’re coming back in Hong Kong, in the heart of the city. You were in the room, you already know why you come back.

events.name: SuperAI 2027
events.description: SuperAI is Asia's largest AI conference, bringing together over 10,000 attendees, 1,500+ AI companies, startups, investors, researchers, and enterprise leaders to explore the latest advancements in artificial intelligence. The event features world-class keynotes, startup competitions, exhibitions, and networking as the anchor event of Singapore AI Week.
